card.summary: Lets an agent reuse a saved answer when the same question comes in again, instead of asking the model each time.
card.example: Many people ask the same policy question each week. The first answer is saved and the rest get it back straight away.
cost: Billed by the hour for the size of cache that is running.
Each reused answer saves one model call, so the saving depends on how often the same question repeats.
needs: A decision on how long a saved answer stays valid, so nobody gets an out-of-date answer.
A rule for what must never be saved, such as answers that include personal details.
card.safety: It would store what people ask and what the agent replied, so it needs the same retention and deletion rules as conversation memory. A saved answer is only reused for people who are allowed to see it.
card.billing: Per hour by cache size and performance tier.
card.note: Check the current Redis options before building, since Azure's older Redis tiers are being retired.
